headlines.title: 特朗普突然向沃什发难，威胁称：美联储不降息就切断和对美顺差国的贸易
headlines.summary: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普加大了对美联储降息的施压，他甚至威胁说若央行按兵不动自己就要切断和逆差对象国的贸易。 特朗普周五在自家社交媒体Truth Social上发帖说：“下调利率，否则我就停止与那些我们有逆差的国家贸易，这是美国最高法院在它荒谬且代价高昂的关税裁决中强烈认可‘总统’绝对有权力做的。这比关税还好！美联储理事会有了很棒的新领导了，必须学聪明起来，变成爱国者吧。高利率让美国陷于非常不公平的劣势地位，而我绝不会允许那种事情发生！”

headlines.title_en: Trump Suddenly Targets Warsh, Threatens: Cut Trade with Surplus Nations if Fed Doesn't Cut Rates
headlines.summary_en: U.S. President Donald Trump intensified pressure on the Federal Reserve to cut interest rates, even threatening to halt trade with countries running surpluses against the U.S. if the central bank stays put. In a post on his social media platform Truth Social on Friday, Trump said: "Cut rates, or I will stop trading with countries with which we have a deficit—an absolute power the 'President' is strongly endorsed to have by the Supreme Court in its ridiculous and costly tariff ruling. This is even better than tariffs! With great new leadership at the Fed, they must get smart and become patriots. High rates put America at a very unfair disadvantage, and I will never allow that to happen!"

headlines.title: Extra funds push Taiwan’s defence spending past NT$1 trillion for the first time
headlines.summary:
Taiwan’s cabinet approved a supplementary defence budget of NT$145.7 billion (US$4.6 billion) on Thursday, pushing the island’s total defence-related spending for this year above NT$1 trillion for the first time.
The additional funding is expected to raise this year’s overall defence spending from 3.32 per cent of gross domestic product (GDP) to about 3.83 per cent, the highest level in decades.

headlines.summary_zh:
台湾行政院周四批准了一项1457亿新台币（约46亿美元）的追加国防预算，使该岛今年的国防相关支出总额首次突破1万亿新台币。
预计这笔额外资金将使今年的整体国防支出从占国内生产总值（GDP）的3.32%提高到约3.83%

headlines.title_en: Baidu Class A Ordinary Shares Added to Stock Connect
headlines.summary_en: The Shanghai Stock Exchange announced that Baidu's Class A ordinary shares and 53 other stocks have been included in the southbound trading eligible securities under Stock Connect, effective Monday (Sept. 7). Citi previously noted that if Baidu is allowed into Stock Connect, it could be a key catalyst for significant capital inflows and buying interest. According to third-party forecasts, Baidu's net new southbound capital could reach $6 billion (about HK$46.8 billion) over the next 2 to 4 months.

headlines.title_en: External disturbances won't shake the resilience of China's capital markets
headlines.summary_en: External disturbances do not alter the robust nature of China's capital markets: Recently, due to factors such as persistently rising US Treasury yields, geopolitical risk disturbances, and expectations of tighter global liquidity, international capital markets have experienced intensified volatility. The A-share market has also been turbulent, especially with faster rotation of hot spots in the tech sector. An economist said in an interview with a Shanghai Securities News reporter that in recent years, with the continuous optimization of China's economic structure, improving quality of listed companies, gradual improvement in investor structure, and ongoing refinement of capital market institutions, the internal forces supporting the healthy and stable operation of the market are strengthening.

headlines.title_en: UK Two-Year Gilt Yield Rises Over 1 Basis Point on US Nonfarm Payrolls Day, Up Over 17 Basis Points This Week
headlines.summary_en: Friday (Sept. 4) European session tail end: UK 10-year gilt yield fell 0.1 basis point to 5.133%, jumping from 5.130% to 5.184% at 20:30 Beijing time when U.S. nonfarm payrolls were released, up 10.3 bps on the week, with a notable gap higher on Sept. 1 and sustained pullbacks on Sept. 2-4. Two-year gilt yield rose 1.2 bps to 4.531%, climbing from around 4.513% daily low to 4.575% upon the payrolls release, up 17.3 bps on the week. This week, the 30-year gilt yield rose 1.6 bps and the 50-year rose 1.1 bps. The 2/10-year gilt yield spread fell 6.986 bps to +60.211 bps.

headlines.title: 上市银行深耕科技金融精准赋能科创实体
headlines.summary: 【上市银行深耕科技金融精准赋能科创实体】A股42家上市银行2026年半年报显示，上半年，科技金融仍是国有大行、股份行等主要商业银行的重点布局领域。综合来看，科技金融市场目前已形成“国有大行压舱托底、股份行机制灵活突围、头部城商行深耕区域”的分层格局。从趋势来看，银行正从单纯信贷投放转向综合化金融服务，以打通科技企业全生命周期金融链条。银行业科技金融也正由规模扩张迈向质效提升新阶段。

headlines.title_en: Listed banks deepen tech finance to precisely empower tech innovators
headlines.summary_en: Listed banks deepen tech finance to precisely empower sci-tech entities: A-share 42 listed banks' 2026 semi-annual reports show that in H1, tech finance remained a key focus for major commercial banks including state-owned big banks and joint-stock banks. Overall, the tech finance market has formed a tiered structure of 'state-owned big banks as ballast, joint-stock banks with flexible mechanisms breaking through, and leading city commercial banks深耕 regional markets.' In terms of trends, banks are shifting from pure credit lending to comprehensive financial services to unlock the full lifecycle financial chain for tech enterprises. The banking sector's tech finance is also moving from scale expansion to a new stage of quality and efficiency improvement.

headlines.title: 康欣新材：因定期报告涉嫌信披违法违规被证监会立案

headlines.title_en: Kangxin New Materials: Under CSRC investigation for suspected violations in periodic report disclosures
headlines.summary_en: Kangxin New Materials: Placed under investigation by CSRC for suspected information disclosure violations in periodic reports: On the evening of September 4, Kangxin New Materials Co., Ltd. (600076.SH) announced that it had received the 'Case Filing Notice' (CSRC Case Filing No. 0042026013) from the China Securities Regulatory Commission on the same day. Due to suspected information disclosure violations in its periodic reports, and in accordance with the Securities Law of the People's Republic of China and the Administrative Penalty Law of the People's Republic of China, the CSRC decided to file a case against the company.

headlines.title_en: Blue Owl Plans to Create Data Center REIT and List It, Sources Say
headlines.summary_en: Sources say Blue Owl Capital is seeking to set up a data center real estate investment trust (REIT) and take it public. As more companies enter capital markets to raise funds for AI infrastructure, data center-related assets are becoming a new financing hotspot. One source, who spoke anonymously as the information is not public, said the alternative asset manager expects to inject about $6.5 billion of its own data center assets into the REIT as seed capital. Blue Owl plans to raise funds through an IPO and subsequent share issuance to acquire more data centers and expand the portfolio.
